description: This file contains unit tests for the GraphOperationBuilder class in the TensorFlow Java API. It verifies various aspects of constructing and configuring graph operations, including setting attributes, adding control inputs, and handling shape specifications.

classes.name: GraphOperationBuilderTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the functionality of GraphOperationBuilder in TensorFlow Java API.

methods.name: failWhenMixingOperationsOnDifferentGraphs
methods.description: Tests that mixing operations from different graphs throws an exception (currently ignored).

methods.name: failOnUseAfterBuild
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to modify an OperationBuilder after build throws an IllegalStateException.

methods.name: failOnUseAfterGraphClose
methods.description: Checks that using a builder after its graph has been closed results in an exception.

methods.name: setAttr
methods.description: Tests setting various attribute types on graph operations, including data types, tensors, strings, bools, and lists.

methods.name: setAttrShape
methods.description: Verifies setting shape attributes on placeholder ops, including unknown shape.

methods.name: setAttrShapeList
methods.description: Tests setting list of shapes as attributes and ensuring shape compatibility.

methods.name: addControlInput
methods.description: Tests adding control dependencies to operations, verifying execution order constraints.

methods.name: testSetAttrShapeList
methods.description: Helper method to test shape list attribute setting with compatible and incompatible shapes.

methods.name: hasNode
methods.description: Helper method to check if a node with a given name exists in the graph.
